name: Qwen Code
invoke: delegate to the `waypost-<role>` subagent (/agents to list them)
notes: Subagents are Markdown + YAML frontmatter in .qwen/agents/ (user level ~/.qwen/agents/). Only the deny-list is emitted: Qwen inherits every tool when `tools` is omitted, and its allowlist uses Gemini-CLI tool names (read_file, run_shell_command…) that are NOT the Claude vocabulary — naming them wrongly would silently strip the role's tools. Custom commands moved from TOML to Markdown in recent versions; roles use the subagent format instead.
